summary.text: Laura Hois is the Republican candidate for Illinois House of Representatives District 81 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Anne Stava (D).
Hois is an attorney and business owner who served as the Downers Grove Township clerk from 2013 to 2017.

paragraphs.text: Hois was born in DeKalb, Illinois, and graduated from Naperville Central High School.
She earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign in 1980 and a law degree from DePaul University College of Law in 1984.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she has more than 30 years of experience as corporate counsel, at law firms and in her own law office in Downers Grove.
According to Ballotpedia, Hois began serving as Republican committeeman for Downers Grove in 2010.
In the survey she said that in 2021 she began attending Downers Grove Community High School District 99 board meetings and founded WakeUpD99, a citizen group focused on school governance.
Hois won the March 17, 2026 Republican primary.
She listed public safety, education and parental involvement, and taxes and government spending among her priorities, and said she opposes the elimination of cash bail under the SAFE-T Act.
